FAQ

Answers before you build

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. Blass Construction Company holds Tennessee General Contractor License #76961 and is licensed and insured in the State of Tennessee.

Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. We offer free consultations and estimates for custom homes, remodels, roofing and commercial projects. Call (865) 388-3600 or use the form above.

Do you build on client-owned lots, and can you help me choose one?

Yes. We build on client-owned lots and offer lot-selection guidance across West Knoxville, Hardin Valley, Sequoyah Hills and surrounding areas, reviewing topography, access, zoning, utilities, soil and HOA restrictions.

Do you handle TVA permits for lakefront builds?

Yes. We coordinate TVA shoreline permit applications as part of the lakefront build process on Fort Loudoun Lake and Tellico Lake, along with any HOA approvals.

How long does a lakefront custom home take to build?

Timelines vary with lot complexity, permits and design scope, but a custom lakefront estate typically takes 12 to 18 months from groundbreaking to completion.

How do I know if my roof needs repair or replacement?

Widespread shingle damage, leaks, sagging and a roof older than about 20 years point to replacement. Isolated leaks or minor damage can often be repaired. We inspect first and recommend the right fix.

How long does a roof replacement take?

Generally a few days to a couple of weeks, depending on the size and complexity of the roof.

Can you help with storm damage and insurance claims?

Absolutely. We specialize in storm-damage assessments and repairs and help homeowners navigate the insurance claims process.

Do you offer warranties?

Yes. We offer workmanship warranties along with manufacturer warranties on materials, plus post-construction support on new homes.
